title: helianthemum × sulphureum var. cupreum
intro: Helianthemum × sulphureum var. cupreum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a hybrid plant species belonging to the Cistaceae family. Rockrose is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the management of skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose are attributed to its antioxidant and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
